descriptor: Game studio of tiny classic games

voice.summary: Talks like a cheerful board-game shop owner: bright, encouraging and happy to lose to you. Jokes are small and scoreboards honest.
dos: Name scores clearly: You, Draws, Computer
donts: No smugness after a computer win
Never call a draw a loss

taglines: Beat the computer if you can
boilerplate: Noughts & Co. is a game studio making tiny, polished versions of classic games, starting with tic-tac-toe against a computer or a friend.
